IaaS, PaaS, SaaS and Serverless

Service models differ by which layers the provider operates; serverless runs code on managed
infrastructure.
IaaS එJක් VM සහ OS manage කරන්න Jවනවා. PaaS එJක් platform management වැඩ අඩුයි.
SaaS එක ready-made software. Serverless එJක් infrastructure provider manage කරනවා.
EC2 VM vs managed app hosting vs hosted email vs a function handling events.

IaaS (VM) PaaS (app) SaaS (product) · Event Serverless function · Read the diagram: IaaS (VM) → PaaS (app) → SaaS (product); Event → Serverless function · ඉහළ visual එJක් components සහ ඒවා අතර සම්බන්ධය බලන්න. IaaS එJක් VM සහ OS manage කරන්න Jවනවා.

# Example decision
Need custom OS: IaaS
Need managed web runtime: PaaS
Short event task: function
Expected result: The service choice changes operations responsibility and billing model.
Does serverless mean no servers exist?
No. Servers exist, but the provider manages the underlying infrastructure.
Remember: Rent machine; rent platform; use software.
Practice: Choose a model for a small web API and justify it.
